rules.title: Requests and limits
rules.text: Set resource requests and limits on every container.

rules.title: ConfigMaps and Secrets
rules.text: Keep configuration in ConfigMaps and Secrets, not in images.

rules.title: Pin image tags
rules.text: Pin images by version or digest, never :latest.

rules.title: Disruption budgets
rules.text: Define PodDisruptionBudgets and multiple replicas for important services.

rules.title: Restrictive security context
rules.text: Run as non-root with a read-only root filesystem and dropped capabilities.

rules.title: Namespaces and RBAC
rules.text: Isolate workloads with namespaces and minimal RBAC.

rules.title: Declarative changes
rules.text: Change cluster state through manifests in git, not kubectl edit.
